text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis and repeated stance against mass production","quality":"position clarity","description":"It states a definite argument early and keeps that position consistent throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"three body paragraphs on cost, carelessness, and machine fault","quality":"organizational structure","description":"It develops its argument in a more deliberate paragraph-by-paragraph order."},{"evidence":"explains why human inattention could increase crashes","quality":"reasoning depth","description":"It does more than name a concern by showing how the concern would actually affect driverless cars."},{"evidence":"uses quoted and paraphrased article details to support claims","quality":"textual support","description":"It anchors its opinion more consistently in evidence from the source article."},{"evidence":"addresses possible benefits before concluding against the cars","quality":"balanced consideration","description":"It shows awareness of the other side and responds to it instead of ignoring it."},{"evidence":"concluding summary of costs and safety risks","quality":"conclusion development","description":"It ends by restating the main reasons in a more complete final paragraph."}]}
